description: Shows a batch made with create_batch: each product’s step (queued, product, plan, planned, starting, generating, done, failed, waiting_credits, skipped), its image_set id (get_image_set has the download links), images done of total, credits, and a plain error for a failed one. Without batch_id: the account’s latest batches. Free. Check every minute or so while products are moving. Example: {"batch_id": "…"}
name: get_batch
title: Check a batch
